propositions.name: bound_transition_identity_and_externally_rooted_authority
propositions.statement: A scientific transition binds subject, problem and criterion, source/evidence basis, representation/evaluator epoch, affected commitments and authority scope; silent material mutation creates a new comparison or invalid transition, and local computation cannot amplify legitimate authority.
propositions.falsifier: Native configuration, metrology, provenance and governance products reproduce every decision with lower cost.

propositions.name: layered_warrant_and_detection_adequacy
propositions.statement: Material source, semantic, model, computational, oracle/test, argument, transport and authority links remain separately evaluable; a pass supports only error classes the evaluator could expose under the registered case and selection history.
propositions.falsifier: Strongest assurance, VVUQ, software-oracle and native-evaluator products make the same decisions with lower cost.

propositions.name: typed_conservation_through_composition
propositions.statement: Relation family, direction, approximation, numerical or semantic loss, uncertainty form, dependence, argument modality, security/privacy transformation and unresolved distinctions cannot silently strengthen or disappear through composition.
propositions.falsifier: Native relation and uncertainty compositions already conserve all claim-relevant types and losses.

propositions.name: plural_support_selective_invalidation_and_reopening
propositions.statement: A claim remains standing only while at least one complete valid sufficient support family survives; invalid evidence, relation, computation, evaluator, security or governance state reopens only dependent commitments.
propositions.falsifier: TMS/ATMS, diagnosis and support-hypergraph parents reproduce every heterogeneous reopen decision.

propositions.name: constructive_exploration_confirmation_separation_and_bounded_closure
propositions.statement: Exploratory and constructive actions may expand observables, representations, instruments and frames without gaining confirmatory authority; closure is relative to a declared search/evaluation universe, residual uncertainty, censored routes and reopening conditions.
propositions.falsifier: Native discovery, experimental-design and stopping parents provide all proposal/status/closure decisions without a common layer.

propositions.name: parent_recovery_local_deference_and_upward_dominance
propositions.statement: A higher theory must recover critical native parent verdicts, remain inactive when a parent is sufficient, and earn upward status through prospective cross-parent strict gain, generativity, transfer, efficiency/resilience and independent evaluation.
propositions.falsifier: F0, F1 or F3 reproduces all protected decisions and prospective generative outputs with equal or lower cost.

propositions.name: machine_native_internal_freedom_external_scientific_witness_and_governed_use
propositions.statement: Machine inquiry may use nonhuman internal representations and search, but adoption requires a claim-relative external witness sufficient for evidence, assumptions, uncertainty, relation, computation, affected commitments, security/privacy, source permissions and authority.
propositions.falsifier: Domain-native certificates and governance interfaces are always sufficient or machine-native gains vanish under strong baselines and witness requirements.

admission_requirements: strongest F0/F1/F3 comparator implementations bound prospectively
at least two materially different naturalistic domains
negative, parent-win and CANNOT_CHECK outcomes retained
